hotspots.title: November Project Austin
hotspots.subtitle: Long Center fields · free wednesday-morning workout, all welcome

info.description: Free outdoor group workout every Wednesday at 6:29am rain or shine. Anyone shows up, anyone fits in. Be on the lawn.

hotspots.title: Lady Bird Lake Loop · Lou Neff Point
hotspots.subtitle: Lou Neff Point · informal jumping-off for the 10-mile loop

info.description: Most popular trailhead for the 10-mile Ann and Roy Butler Hike-and-Bike Trail. Informal weekend group runs gather here at dawn most Saturdays.

hotspots.title: Barton Springs Pool · Morning Swim Crew
hotspots.subtitle: 2201 William Barton Dr · 68° year-round spring-fed pool

info.description: Iconic 68° spring-fed swimming pool. Year-round morning lap-swimmers gather most days; informal community feel. Closed Thursdays for cleaning.

hotspots.title: Austin Runners Club · Sunday Long Run
hotspots.subtitle: Lady Bird Lake · free weekly long run, multiple pace groups

info.description: Free weekly Sunday long run with pace groups from beginner to marathon training. Meets near Auditorium Shores; routes vary 4-20+ miles.

hotspots.title: Barton Creek Greenbelt · Trail Run Meetup
hotspots.subtitle: Spyglass Trailhead · weekly Saturday trail runs

info.description: Informal weekly trail-running gathering from the Spyglass Trailhead. Distances vary; bring water and shoes that handle rocks.

hotspots.title: Lady Bird Lake · Paddle Meetup
hotspots.subtitle: Texas Rowing Center · group paddles + casual kayaks

info.description: Kayak / SUP / canoe rental and launch on Lady Bird Lake. Informal group paddles in the cooler months; rentals available daily.
